quickstart.example_input: Google Doc link + project “Q1 Campaign” + description “Client X campaign brief draft”, pasted into Inbox

items.description: Full launch task tracker for 9YM covering game material, marketing, SDK, QA, CS
96-slide game overview and competitor analysis (vs Moonlight Blade, Sword of Shadows) with SWOT
Maps roughly 30 CN-server patches (2015-2019) to a planned TH OBT patch timeline
Optimistic/Realistic/Pessimistic revenue and UA forecast for 9YM, benchmarked against CABAL Mobile's historical actuals
HOF company profile - CEO bio and social reach, vision/mission, headcount, product list, 2026 campaigns
Tales Runner product profile - genre, monetization, competitors, launch history, Aug 2026 performance
WarZ TH product profile, 9-title competitor comparison, daily DAU/CCU/revenue tracking Jun-Aug 2026
Season 1 GTM strategy hub - brand, objectives, audience, positioning, player journey
Team operating guidebook - how to use the strategy, six team playbooks, brief-approval test
Team Playbook Proposal workbook - master KPIs, RACI, execution examples, 11-item open decision log

integrations.name: Canva
integrations.role: Slide decks & designs (text extraction confirmed — D-008)

tasks.task: Confirm and connect the vault folder
Hand-write 3–5 sample notes across a few different pilot projects or clients
Build one Bases view over the sample notes, showing date and description columns
Confirm the view answers real lookup questions; adjust schema if not
Decide what counts as "key information" for an image (D-006)
Decide note lifecycle / archiving policy (D-007)
Set up the Inbox convention (folder or note), capturing project name and a short description at intake
Draft and finalize the rule table for known Drive/Canva locations, per company and project
Test Canva connector text extraction on one real client design (D-008)
Run the pipeline manually end-to-end on one source per format
Review and correct AI-inferred categorizations from the trial run
Turn the pipeline into a repeatable checklist or prompt
Build the rule table as an editable config file
Set up a Cowork scheduled task fired on demand (optional)
Evaluate whether volume justifies a standalone script
Build standalone script calling Google/Canva/Claude APIs directly (only if triggered)
Add a Sources view to the nova-tracker website (project, description, date, format)
Build a local web app to browse Sources and submit to the Inbox (user-requested, D-015)
Usability-test the app as a first-time user; add a no-terminal launcher (D-017)
Add clickable detail/project pages, an in-app Needs Review action, and local search (user-requested, D-018)

tests.validates: Every field captures what's actually needed
Views return the right notes when filtered/grouped
One real source per format runs without manual fixes
Rule + AI-fallback calls correct on 10 sample sources
Re-submitting a source updates, not duplicates, the note

impact.note: Targets, not measurements — nothing's built or tested yet (see Test Status).

items.before: Knowledge lost when a project wraps

decisions.label: Image key info — resolved: on-image text + basic context
Note lifecycle — resolved: stays in place, indefinitely
Company-level vs. project notes — resolved: scope field
Canva ≠ automatic Creative Asset — resolved: narrowed the rule
GTM strategy docs → Campaign Brief, AI-inferred, needs human confirmation
Local web app built (browse + submit) — doesn't process sources itself
Found + fixed a gray-matter parse-cache bug while building the app
App usability-tested as a first-time user; no-terminal launcher added
Detail/project pages, in-app review action, local search (not live AI)

build_gate: Phase 1 complete — all 6 source formats have run through the pipeline at least once (CSV/image/text via disposable test fixtures on 2026-09-22, pending a real source of each), dedupe/update-in-place confirmed, and the 7 pilot notes reviewed. Phase 2 (semi-automate) underway: checklist and machine-readable rule table done; a Cowork scheduled task (task #14, optional) is the only thing left.
